sources.summary: As the overview of the FIFA World Cup 2026 cities continues, we move on to what is currently the most livable city in North America , Vancouver . Dubbed the city of glass by artist Douglas Coupland, who was referring to the downtown's dominant steel-and-glass architectural aesthetic, the city actually boasts diverse architecture, from 20th-century Edwardian buildings to unique 21st-century modernist sites.
